* '''PC-E1''' ([[Cardo (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 10 August 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While an [Episode VII] objective on table, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is •Arm Cannon (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 &gt; defense value).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Cardo]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Cardo]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Cardo”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 12 December 2025<ref name="ht-cd-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5637ac6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/cardo.gif cardo.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac6 5637ac6] (12 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: the affiliation icon at the top left is redrawn (a different emblem). Game text unchanged. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While an [Episode VII] objective on table, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is •Arm Cannon (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 > defense value).”
